meta.title: Open / Public Tender: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Verify that Open/Public Tender is unavailable on the Growth plan and available on the Enterprise plan for the same buyer; the catalog has no step to inspect plan-gated tender capability or switch to an Enterprise tenant without a named tenant ID.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that Open/Public Tender is unavailable on the Growth plan and available on the Enterprise plan for the same buyer; the catalog has no step to inspect plan-gated tender capability or switch to an Enterprise tenant without a named tenant ID.

steps.note: Reach the buyer's events area where event-creation capabilities would normally be accessed.
Confirm the events list is rendered before the unsupported plan comparison.

args.need: verify that Open/Public Tender is absent or refused on the Growth tenant, then repeat with the same buyer on an Enterprise tenant and confirm it is available

steps.note: The catalog cannot inspect tenant plans or test the Open/Public Tender capability across Growth and Enterprise tenants.
Provide a final assertion after the tester interaction that the buyer remains on a valid events-list screen.
